title: Northstar synthetic plan: reimbursement claim deadline
source: CC0 synthetic training fixture; fictional policy statement
text: TRAINING FIXTURE — FICTIONAL POLICY. A Northstar member must submit a reimbursement claim within 90 calendar days after receiving an eligible covered service. The submission must include an itemized receipt showing the provider, service date, service description, and amount paid. A missing receipt may delay review, and the plan administrator may request additional documentation. This fictional plan does not promise that every receipt will be approved or that payment occurs within a fixed number of days. The date of service, not the date a member notices a charge, starts the stated submission window. This sample does not describe coordination with another insurer, appeals, or exceptions for emergencies. The assistant should cite the claim-deadline passage and avoid inventing an upload URL, claim number, or reimbursement status. This content is synthetic and contains no real participant data.
